## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the reusable skill problem and what an agent will do differently. Link the shared issue, if one exists; use `Fixes #...` only when this change resolves it.

## Validation

Record the checks actually run and remaining limitations. For scripts, include a meaningful success and failure case. Use a small fictional case for project-derived behavior.

## Portability

- [ ] Instructions and helpers work without another project's checkout, private profile, paths or infrastructure.
- [ ] No application passport, project settings, raw project findings or private evidence was included.
- [ ] Links lead to files in this repository or authoritative upstream sources.
